title: Theo and the Bakery
author: Ines Galloway
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
